conventions.visibility: Exact declared lifecycle and positive own/ancestor opacity. No guessed viewport/font clipping; active frame bounds are conservative for actual ink.
conventions.lineHeight: Default is fontSize*1.2; numeric is authored pixels; percentage converted for inventory only, raw value retained.
conventions.worldLinear: [a,b,c,d] maps local dx/dy to world[a*dx+c*dy,b*dx+d*dy]. worldYCorrectionVector maps a local text-y correction to worlddx/dy.
conventions.ancestorScales: Triples [scaleX,scaleY,rotation] correspond in order to nodes[].ancestors; own node scale is separate.
